one_star_reviews.text:
The worst experience of my life; I'm extremely disappointed with Teo i Carles / Gestem's management.

In our case, we were managing a rental through Teo i Carles, a company that, we were told, had been integrated into or absorbed by Gestem. The experience was very negative. We received a draft contract with internal contradictions, errors in dates and amounts, and unclear clauses regarding repairs, the security deposit, expenses, and the tenant's responsibilities.

When we asked for reasonable clarification before signing, Núria's response was defensive, unempathetic, and completely unprofessional. Instead of facilitating a calm review of the contract, we felt pressured to accept the conditions quickly, even being told that they could offer the apartment to other interested parties if we raised any objections. Reviewing a rental agreement before signing it should be standard practice, not a source of stress.

We were also not given a pre-visit to check the final condition of the property after some minor repairs had been carried out, even though there were elements whose condition we wanted to document before handing it over.

The only person who treated us properly was Dolors, who was indeed kind and courteous. Unfortunately, the rest of the process left us with a feeling of a lack of transparency, a lack of empathy, and too much pressure to close the deal quickly.

In a transaction as important as renting a home, clarity, professionalism, and trust are expected. Our experience with Teo i Carles / Gestem was precisely the opposite.

A very bad experience with Grup Gestem. In our case, during the management of a rental, the treatment we received from Nuria and Jaume was extremely unpleasant and unprofessional. We felt pressured and treated in a way that I consider completely unacceptable for a company that should manage something as important as a home with transparency, respect, and seriousness.

The communication was tense, the interpersonal skills left much to be desired, and the final feeling was one of helplessness and exhaustion. We decided not to pursue legal action to avoid wasting more time and energy, but I believe it is important to document our experience so that others can take it into account before entrusting them with any housing-related matters.

I absolutely do not recommend them. For me, it has been a profoundly negative experience.

Very bad experience with AguaViva.

They advised us on installing an under-sink water filtration system from scratch. Alejandro created the plan after receiving videos of the sink and the main water supply. He recommended a Big White double-casing pre-filtration system along with a triplex microfiltration unit, assuring us that installation was very simple.

However, when we received the Big White system, we realized it wasn't technically feasible to install. We consulted with several plumbers, sending them the same video we had previously shared, and they all agreed that they couldn't install this system.

Customer service was slow and unhelpful, and the refund took over a month and a half.

Furthermore, some products are priced far above market value. For example, they tried to sell us a Metal Free Forum faucet for €365, when we found it in other stores for almost half the price.

We were also offered a GIE Mini vitalizer (€1,370), which they claimed was handcrafted by “Water Evolution” to order. Searching for this name brings up a luxury faucet brand that seems unrelated to this product, which is quite confusing. We also couldn't find clear or verifiable information about how the device actually works, nor about the company itself, which made us suspicious.

Overall, a very negative experience. I wouldn't recommend it.

UPDATE REGARDING THE COMPANY'S RESPONSE:

The company's claims are false. Not only was the initial advice and planning poor, but the AV PRO triplex system they recommended subsequently failed seriously:

• Health hazard: The Carbonit GFP P200 cartridge (custom-ordered) fits so tightly in its non-official casing that, when it expanded with the water, it burst and became clogged. We unknowingly consumed stagnant water for over a month.

• Negligence: The manufacturer Carbonit confirmed that their cartridges should only be used in their official housings to prevent this.

• Complete lack of professionalism: The installation was done by a professional plumber. Even so, Alejandro passed the buck, blamed the installation, and refused to take responsibility for the design flaw or compatibility issue with the system he himself configured for us.

- Furthermore, the manufacturer of the GIE Mini is the inventor's wife, and Agua Viva is the only distributor because, according to Alejandro, they hold the patent.

A dangerous and disastrous situation. Not recommended at all.

one_star_reviews.text:
Yesterday, Sunday, May 31, I went to the emergency room because I had noticed a lump in my right breast for days.
My mother is currently suffering from breast cancer and although I am 26 years old, it is considered that I have a much higher risk than other people of suffering from it too.
After waiting almost 3 hours in the emergency room with a practically empty waiting room except for two people who were also waiting to be treated like me. Finally, after the screening where I was already told that I would not be tested, I went in with a doctor. The first thing she did was scold me and ask me why I came to the emergency room and did not go to my gynecologist. That what I had was not an emergency. My answer was: I have been waiting 3 hours to be treated and my mother has breast cancer. I have a report from a genetic study where it says that I must have continuous monitoring to prevent or quickly detect a possible cancer.
After this lack of tact and empathy, she proceeded to palpate me and told me that I had a fibroadenoma (benign tumor) in my right breast but that I still had to have a breast ultrasound to confirm it. There was an ultrasound machine next to me. Which she herself could have used in 2 minutes to confirm that it was nothing bad and leave me alone. But she didn't.
I will go to the gynecologist to confirm the diagnosis, which by the way she didn't put in the report to protect herself in case it is malignant, but I'm telling you, that whatever it is, we will meet again for medical negligence. I am a person like anyone else and I deserve respect and empathy. By the way, her name is ANNA VILA FAMADA and she is a gynecologist.

one_star_reviews.text: The center called me for a visit, and I told them I couldn't walk and needed an ambulance. They replied that they couldn't do anything, so I couldn't go to the visit because they wouldn't send an ambulance. Hopefully, I'll be lucky and can go to the visit tomorrow.

I went to this medical center seeking a solution for sesamoiditis in my big toe, which I've been dealing with for months. I specifically went for a recommended injection after extensive treatment and follow-up with a specialized physiotherapist, equipped with advanced technology such as ultrasound, shockwave therapy, Indiba, and inductive magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

The experience was very disappointing. The consultation lasted approximately four minutes. The doctor barely examined my foot and even told me she "didn't know what was there," although she acknowledged it was probably the same thing I'd been describing from the beginning. Even so, she ruled out any treatment and told me I needed an MRI and several more visits before even considering an injection. She didn't even bother to perform an ultrasound.

The worst part wasn't just the lack of solutions, but paying €70 for an extremely brief consultation, with hardly any examination or clear medical guidance. I left feeling like I'd wasted my time and money.

I fully understand that we need to act with caution, but I also expect professionalism, interest, and attention commensurate with the price charged.

I want to share the awful experience we had at this campsite. We came to spend two nights as a family—my wife, our three children, and I—hoping to enjoy a few peaceful days, but it turned out to be a complete disaster.

Our stay coincided with the World Cup final in Spain, and since we were staying at the campsite, we decided to watch it in the bar. That's where the nightmare began. The service was terrible: absolute chaos when ordering, no organization, barely audible on the TV, and very low-quality food, practically all frozen and with the quality of a supermarket.

The bar was completely packed with families enjoying the match and buying drinks nonstop. The business was raking in the cash thanks to the event, and we were all experiencing an exciting final. But when the referee blew the final whistle and Spain was crowned champion, something happened that I'd never seen before. A waiter, a man with glasses whose name I don't know, rudely turned off the TV and kicked everyone out of the bar.

Many of us customers were outraged. We just wanted to stay a few more minutes to see our team lift the trophy. Furthermore, the bar itself continued serving drinks. However, the response was to turn off the television and rudely ask everyone to leave.

The worst was yet to come. A customer rightly criticized the waiter's disrespectful attitude towards those of us who were there, and the waiter confronted him aggressively, almost coming to blows. Witnessing such a tense and violent scene in front of so many families and children was utterly shameful.

And as if all this weren't enough, the night before we had ordered several croissants for breakfast. When we went to pick them up, we were told that the waiter who had served us hadn't written down the order and that, according to them, he was such a bad worker that he had been fired that very day.

To top it all off, we left our car parked in the campsite parking lot, and someone hit it, smashing the left headlight, scratching the bumper, and damaging the fender.

All of this happened to us in just 24 hours of our stay. We still have one more night here, and honestly, we can't wait to leave.

We will never return, and of course, we cannot recommend a place where the service is so appalling, the organization so poor, and the customer service so shameful.
Noise level
Very loud, hard to hear

A regrettable experience, especially due to the attitude of the waiter, who we understand was also the owner or manager of the bar.

We were watching the World Cup final, and as soon as the match ended, this man abruptly turned off the television and practically kicked us out of the establishment, not even allowing us to see the medal ceremony or the moment they lifted the Cup.

His attitude was cold, unpleasant, and completely lacking in consideration for the customers who had been enjoying drinks during the match. When we asked him to wait a few minutes so we could see the end of the celebration, he showed no interest or intention of granting such a reasonable request. He simply turned off the television and made it clear that we had to leave.

We weren't asking to stay another hour, but rather to be able to watch for a few minutes the most important moment of a final that only happens once every four years. A minimum of empathy, courtesy, and common sense would have sufficed.

The way the waiter or owner handled the situation was highly unprofessional and completely ruined the experience. A hospitality business isn't just about serving and taking payments; it's also about treating customers well.

We left feeling like we were a nuisance as soon as the match ended. I certainly wouldn't recommend it after this experience.

one_star_reviews.text:
I doubt the "Tech" part. The "Gallery" part, okay, I'll let it slide.
It was recommended to me as a technical service, but it's just a shop selling cases and spare parts. Let me explain. I took my Samsung Galaxy S24 in to have the screen repaired. I broke it myself, and that's that. I had to pay whatever it cost.
March 2026, cost: 280 euros, because they had to replace the frame, the screen, and the screen itself included the touch sensor, the stylus holder, and a bunch of other components. Okay, I accepted it, that's how it is. Initially, the stylus didn't quite fit as it used to, but since everything seemed to be working fine and the change was barely noticeable because it didn't stick out of the case and "it's normal when you replace the screen" (according to them), fine, leave it as is.
End of May 2026. A little water got into the phone through the corner of the stylus holder—only through that corner, it wasn't submerged. It shut down instantly. I'm terrified. I'm going to the Samsung website. It's normal; high-end phones shut down as a safety precaution when they detect water ingress. Instructions followed to the letter: remove everything removable, in this case the USB drive (only two drops of water came out of the hole and the SIM tray). I left the phone upright on absorbent paper for at least 24 hours. It's 9 PM. Do not try to turn it on. The next day, after only 20 hours, I took it to Tecnogallery. The first thing they did was try to turn it on. I continued. They sent it to the technical service. Ten days after leaving it. Diagnosis after seven days: it's unusable due to attempts to turn it on. There's no warranty for repairing the frame and screen (it hadn't even been three months). It's supposed to be IP68, but what do I do? Go to court? 300 euros. They repair it with my consent. I called Tecnogallery to ask if they had returned it. "It's fixed, but we're waiting for them to do another repair to save on shipping." In the end, 28 days, four weeks to get the phone back. Warranty not accepted, and a month without service. Mobile. The best part was "I should have brought it in right away." I wonder if they were open at 9 PM.
Draw your own conclusions. As I said, it's a phone case shop. Technical service? You're better off taking your phone to an authorized service center.
The last star in the rating goes to the guys in the shop. Friendliness and helpfulness, no complaints there. But as for the business itself, the franchise I suppose, if I could, I'd give it a negative rating.

I called on a Sunday morning to order a chicken. The phone service was very disappointing. The woman who answered barely gave me time to finish my order. As soon as I gave her my name, it seemed like she wanted to hang up. I had to interrupt to ask if they had sausages, and she replied very curtly, “No, we don’t have them. God, God, God,” and hung up without letting me finish.

I had also intended to order potatoes, croquettes, and other things, but she didn't give me the chance. I understand that they might be very busy on a Sunday, but that doesn't excuse treating a customer like that.

In the end, I decided to order from another rotisserie and didn't even go to pick up the chicken I had ordered. Obviously, I didn't call back to cancel the order either, because after how she treated me on the phone, I had no intention of speaking to her again.

Much friendlier customer service and giving customers a few seconds to finish their order would make a huge difference.

To the owner's response: I stand by my version of events. The call lasted barely 15 seconds, so saying I took my time "very generously" is simply not true. I just received rushed and unfriendly service. I also see that the negative reviews of this establishment are always met with the response that the customer is lying, instead of any self-reflection. My review only reflects my experience.

one_star_reviews.text:
The location and setting of the house are exceptional. The living areas are fantastic, as are the spacious bedrooms. Everything is in place for an exceptional vacation.

However, our experience (4 couples, each with one child under 2 years old, and a pregnant woman) turned into a nightmare. Upon arrival, the temperature in each bedroom was 27 degrees Celsius, and the concierge's goodwill was immediately put to the test (4 fans were distributed for the second night). During our 5 nights there in the heatwave, the temperature in our rooms never dropped below 27.5 degrees Celsius. The nights were dreadful for our children and us.

And it doesn't end there. Now that we have requested compensation for the inconvenience, given the price of the night, we are being told that the air conditioning system is working properly and shows no problems. After some "extensive" investigation, it turns out the air conditioning is connected to the water heating system, and given our very high hot water consumption (late morning and evening), this was affecting its proper functioning.

Funny to read, considering we were in the middle of a heatwave and several of us preferred to shower in the open air using the pool shower rather than sweltering in the 30-degree bathrooms.

And for a house that can accommodate 4 couples (4 bedrooms) + 4 children (4 beds in the dormitory), so 12 people in total, it's hard to understand why the system can't handle 5 or 6 people showering in a single day without the air conditioning shutting off…

We're going to keep fighting to get a resolution because our vacation is ruined and some friends had to leave early because of this…

P.S.: Don't expect to be lounging on the supposedly beautiful low sofas lined up along the seafront. They only exist in the photos, and the sun loungers/garden furniture won't last another summer given their dilapidated state.

I stayed at Casa Enmitan this year.

This stay was by far the worst I've ever experienced. The house doesn't match the photos. It's dirty and dilapidated; it's clearly more of a party venue than a relaxing family vacation spot. But the worst part was the air conditioning. It didn't work at all during our stay, even though we were in the middle of a heatwave and had specifically booked a house with air conditioning because we have babies a few months old and there was a pregnant woman in the group. The staff brought us fans (one per room), but in a room that was 28 degrees Celsius (82 degrees Fahrenheit), it didn't do much. The living room shutter was broken, so the heat still poured in despite our efforts to keep it closed during the day; it was unbearable.

We left before the end of our stay because it was just too much to bear in that heat. We asked for financial compensation, but apparently it was our hot water consumption (yes, apparently we took hot showers in our bathrooms at 28 degrees Celsius… it's ridiculous) that prevented the air conditioning from working properly. And don't even get me started on my son's condition at the end of the week: he couldn't sleep, cried constantly, was always sweating, coughing… In short, it was a disgrace.

It's a disgrace that a café serves such bad coffee. Almost two euros for a cortado that's poorly tamped, has no foam, and is completely watery... I'd understand it in a cheap bar on the outskirts of town, but in a "café" in the center of Barcelona?

I feel more cheated than ever. I have to write this because if I had read a review like mine, I would have saved myself a lot of grief, wasted time, money, and health. Last year, I took the "experiential workshop" at his office, following the geo-environmental study he had done for me a few months earlier due to a sleep disorder. I undertook an expensive renovation based on his report to make my bedroom a suitable place for sleeping well, something I've never been able to achieve there, in my personal experience. It's been a year of treatments, doctors, and physiotherapists, without finding the cause. Now, three weeks ago, after changing rooms, I don't have half the symptoms. But what I want to denounce isn't just this.

At the workshop, Mr. León told me I was very sensitive and that he was counting on me for the course. When I told him it seemed very expensive, he replied that I would have a guaranteed job because he didn't have anyone in Girona. He sent me the one-year study plan and the invoice for €3,900. I made a point of paying for it, started the course, and after two months, I found out that it wasn't a year-long course, but rather "until the teacher decides otherwise"... That shocked me a lot, because I'm a teacher and I take responsibility for deadlines and the results of my teaching.
Besides this, I had asked her some questions about the teaching materials she gave us on the first day, which we never looked at or discussed again. These notebooks had blurry sections, and we had asked her on several occasions—not just me—for us to provide us with usable materials. She ignored us. Furthermore, they contained confusing phrases and information. I asked her for clarification in the WhatsApp group, which she ignored. During the meetings, there was hardly any way to ask her anything: we started around 10:00 AM, and by 2:00 PM we already had to be at the restaurant. Several times, instead of holding both weekend sessions, she only held one with the same schedule. The few questions he answered were answered in such a way that you couldn't delve any deeper without seeming pushy. Between breakfasts and lunches, we practiced dowsing without clear explanations of the technique to ensure accuracy, always emphasizing that we were "novices" and incapable of doing it independently. The measurements were also taken very quickly, without detailing how to use the machines or how to solve housing problems, which aren't just about moving the bed... I'm not the only one; many in our group felt this way, but because there's a lot of dependence on him for various reasons (buying machines, discounts, preferential treatment), no one dares to tell him. I did mention it again, after he ignored my repeated questions, that the price seemed exorbitant for the few hours dedicated to the course, that before we paid he hadn't told us anything about having to repeat it, and that I had noticed many inconsistencies. His first response was: "If you don't like it, don't come." But I politely replied that if he didn't want to refund the money for the half of the course I hadn't taken, I intended to continue attending, which he refused.
After that phone conversation, when he spoke to me in a very arrogant and humiliating manner, he removed me from the WhatsApp group, didn't send me the location of the next meeting, and is putting a lot of pressure on me "with his lawyers" (it must be a cheaper strategy for him than fulfilling his obligation) to get me to sign a document with abusive and illegal clauses (completely demonstrable and null and void) that limit my freedom of expression, in exchange for returning what is rightfully mine. Now it's no wonder there are hardly any negative reviews of his activities. Let's see if he's capable of ignoring me now or justifying that this review isn't true.

Technical support is unresponsive to defects in a new product:

We bought a Homeland Ultimate vacuum cleaner (order number: 2353137) two weeks ago, and from the very first use, the battery suddenly drains when it still shows more than 30%.

I've written to customer service, called them, and also submitted the form on their website. Ten days have passed, and all I've received is an incident number.

I find it unacceptable that a new product should malfunction and that it's impossible to get a response from customer service.

I hope that, at least through this review, someone will contact me to resolve the issue. If not, I will have to find other ways to file a complaint.

After a year of using my cordless stick vacuum (Taurus Ideal Avant 29.6), the end of the brush—the plastic joint that allows the handle to rotate as you move it across the floor—came apart while I was using it as usual. The technical service has exceeded the three-year warranty period for use. In short, I don't recommend buying a product that no longer has the quality it once did. I just want to make more people aware of this so they don't have the same problem. (We have a three-year consumer goods law, but the vast majority of products sold don't even come close to that lifespan, and on top of that, people get away with it). Honestly, I prefer to buy Miele or Liebherr; they're more expensive, but they last longer, and you don't have any problems with either the service or the product.

Thanks.

one_star_reviews.text:
La Bisbal d’Empordà is well-connected to the interior and the Costa Brava. It has positive aspects that the local administration is not taking advantage of, and the goal should be to create a city that offers a high quality of life while respecting the environment.

Some infrastructure is inadequate or deficient. The sidewalks need improvement. There is a lack of lighting at priority crossings (Directive 2008/96/EC). The Library's maintenance team is working on this.

There is concern about insecurity (thefts). Speeding is rampant and unchecked. Nighttime festivals operate without regard for schedules or the need for rest (La Bisbal, Cruïlles, etc.). There is no police presence at the weekly market; a pair of pickpockets tried to steal my bag, and there are others...be careful.

Antisocial behavior is always a widespread problem in many municipalities: with pets, improper littering, noise (motorcycles, low-quality nighttime festivals exceeding 25 dB nighttime bedroom noise (Decree 176/2009)), or a resident ripping out their fiber optic connection box (Aigüeta Street), leaving users in the area without service for two or three days...

Another important and costly issue is garbage collection, including updating containers and adjusting the fleet size. The project is being implemented in three phases, with the goal of establishing a pay-as-you-go and/or "smart" collection system by 2027, aiming for a clean waste rate of 65% (Directive (EU-2018/851)) by 2035; currently, in La Bisbal, the rate is 39%. The phased approach seeks to introduce a system that must be accepted, integrated, and natural for citizens, encouraging their attention, participation, and transparency. The idea is sound, with a technical and scientific approach, but also an electoral one. And it's true that paper and presentations can be used to make anything. It's positive that the town council wants to control this management.

Some argue that because the mayor doesn't live in La Bisbal, he can't see the municipality's problems firsthand. I don't consider this a problem. The channel for information and action must be the citizens, who should have direct participation to guarantee continuous improvement and social cohesion. The mayor should be a facilitator in managing these actions.

Another problem is that Between 70% and 80% of the municipality lies within a flood zone (ACA). This is particularly noticeable during periods of heavy rainfall. A relief channel, including weirs, flood control zones, protective structures, and bridges, is under study for implementation by 2030 (desirable flow rates of 250 m³/s and less than 2.5 m/s). Added to this are sewage leaks in central areas, which are not easily resolved.

Regarding the Primary Care Center (CAP) expansion, the mistake was made of not consulting with the health authorities before carrying out the expropriations. When the project was presented, the health authorities rejected it. They should not excuse themselves by blaming the previous administration. This situation is a consequence of the errors of all managers and politicians (both current and former). As a compromise, a parking lot has been built, which is not an elegant solution. Meanwhile, to avoid losing the REACT-EU funding, the proposals are to relocate the CAP and/or revise the expansion plan. This is the result of applying for funding before having a project in place. Developed. It shows a lack of planning.

Economic resources are scarce: no industrial activity, small businesses with high turnover, and administrative services typical of a regional capital, which generate significant expenses. However, with professionalism and prudence, these shouldn't be decisive factors.

The library staff and the police... should belong to the Generalitat (the regional government). By design.

If you consider visiting this town, exploring it, going to one of the shops (ceramics or antiques), assessing the location and surroundings, or even living here, you'll realize that, despite everything, a portion of the population is attentive and has a genuine interest and desire for the town to prosper. If this is the case, I wish you the best of luck in your decision. Thank you very much for your time.

Train your employees better, including in customer service! (It's not all about paperwork.) Because that's where you can tell if a company is going to survive or not.

Last week, around June 11th, they notified the mechanic that the car would be ready on June 19th. I've been waiting since June 8th. It's now June 18th, and yesterday they told the mechanic they still haven't even looked at the car since June 8th, the day they were supposed to. I left the car with them two weeks in advance and notified them. I'm not satisfied. With that, they agreed with the mechanic that he would fix it, and when the guy showed up at the garage to get an update, they had supposedly already started looking at it. In short, both the mechanic who usually helps me and I were left waiting for them to call so they could find out what the problem was and take it to be fixed. And to make matters worse, the guy kept calling and they never answered the phone. I called and they didn't answer either. I had to contact Ford Spain and explain the situation because I've been without a car for a total of half a month and nobody is giving us any explanations or updates. Having said that, I don't recommend anyone buy a Ford because then they treat you in such a terrible way and don't even bother to contact the staff. one_star_reviews.text:
Our experience was terrible. We paid for a vacation to relax and enjoy the house, but it was impossible.

Throughout our stay, the temperature inside the house was 32°C (90°F), both day and night, making it impossible to rest or be comfortable. The worst part is that, after our complaints, the real estate agency itself verbally admitted that the price of the house was lower precisely because it didn't have air conditioning. At no point were we informed that the conditions of the house were so extreme, since not having air conditioning is one thing, but the house being practically uninhabitable due to the heat is quite another.

On the day of our arrival, the house wasn't even clean. We had to wait while the cleaning company did its job because, as they explained to us (and we must commend their professionalism and kindness), the real estate agency had forgotten to include the house in the cleaning schedule. This forced us to wait on the terrace, enduring the high temperatures with an 11-month-old baby.

As if all this weren't enough, both the furniture and many of the household items were in poor condition and clearly needed to be renovated or replaced. They were not up to the standard expected of a holiday rental for which a considerable price is paid.

On the second-to-last day of our stay, the gardeners appeared, saying they needed to come in to carry out maintenance. We politely asked them to leave it for the following day, as we were leaving then. We don't understand why this type of work is scheduled while guests are staying, instead of being done between bookings.

In short, the feeling was one of absolute disorganization and very little consideration for guests. Between the unbearable heat, the lack of cleanliness upon our arrival, the state of the furniture and utensils, and the constant disturbances during our stay, our holiday was completely ruined. We would not recommend this accommodation, nor would we book with this agency again.

The condition of the accommodation was absolutely unacceptable and did not correspond to the advertised conditions. From the moment of arrival we noticed a clear lack of cleanliness, maintenance and hygiene.

The jacuzzi was dirty, with stagnant water and in very poor condition. There were abandoned cushions outside, which showed that the house had not been properly conditioned after the stay of the previous guests.

The pool area presented a safety risk. The surrounding wood was raised and had holes, so a simple bad step could have caused a fall or injury. In addition, the saltwater pool cleaner was completely broken and unusable.

The interior of the house was also not in good condition. The oven, microwave and dishes were dirty. The kitchen had a significant presence of ants and a general state of neglect. Several drawers did not open, there were raised door frames, dirty walls, rooms with visible dampness and peeling paint. Added to all this was a strong smell of damp and mold that made the stay very unpleasant.

It should be noted that all these incidents were communicated to you as soon as we arrived, along with photographs that proved the real state of the accommodation. Therefore, you were aware of them from the very beginning.

It is true that one night the police came to the house. After checking the situation, the same officers verified that there was no uncivil behavior; we were simply gathered in the garden and in the pool area.

For this reason, it is false to state, as is made in the review, that the police had to intervene on more than one occasion. This statement does not correspond to the facts and offers a distorted picture of what happened during our stay. Furthermore, the review is completely inconsistent with the reality of our experience, especially considering the poor condition in which we found the property from the start, a circumstance that we immediately communicated to you and that we documented with photographs.

We consider that the condition of the accommodation constitutes a breach of the minimum conditions of cleanliness, maintenance and safety that any guest has the right to expect.
